text: 商务部对外贸易司负责人贺少军表示，顺差反映出国际分工的深刻演变。回顾全球经济发展史，各国在工业化进程中普遍经历了贸易顺差的阶段，英国、美国、日本、德国等制造强国都曾长期保持贸易顺差。从行业产品看，美国芯片80%用于出口，波音公司交付的商用飞机约2/3销往北美以外的客户。欧盟的汽车、药品、化妆品，2025年顺差分别为922亿、2146亿和116亿美元。出口多、顺差大不等于产能过剩。中国实现贸易顺差，反映出中国的产业体系完备高效，是全球分工体系和贸易格局变化的客观结果。
text_en: He Shaojun, an official of the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Foreign Trade, stated that trade surpluses reflect the deep evolution of the international division of labor. Reviewing global economic history, countries generally experienced trade surpluses during industrialization, including manufacturing powers like the UK, US, Japan, and Germany. By industry, 80% of US chips are for export, and about two-thirds of Boeing's commercial aircraft deliveries are to non-North American customers. In 2025, the EU's surpluses in automobiles, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics were $92.2 billion, $214.6 billion, and $11.6 billion, respectively. High exports and large surpluses do not equate to overcapacity. China's trade surplus reflects its complete and efficient industrial system, an objective outcome of changes in the global division of labor and trade patterns.
